projects.description: ML web app that predicts Islamabad house prices from scraped Zameen.com data. Nine models compared — XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost — served through a Streamlit dashboard.
Visual AI workflow builder where every node is an LLM decision (YES/NO). Runs 100% locally via Ollama — no API key, no cloud spend.
Real-time face recognition attendance system. Recognised faces are logged to Oracle DB with timestamps; a Streamlit dashboard handles reports and student management.
Multi-tenant SaaS billing engine. Idempotent usage metering, quota enforcement (429/402), AI token cost calculation, and Stripe Checkout — all on FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
